## About
Camilo Automotive Garage is a neighborhood repair shop on NW 79th Ave in Hialeah Gardens. We work on all makes and models, from a simple consult to a full car inspection.
Our techs are ASE trained and certified, and we use high quality replacement parts at fair prices. We value our work and your safety.
Drivers rate us 4.8 from 128 Google reviews. Got a rattling muffler or air-conditioning that's on strike again? Bring it by.

## Services
- Steering and Suspension: Alignment, shocks and struts, and rack n pinion work.
- Maintenance and inspections: Oil changes and inspections, from a simple consult to a full car inspection.
- Computer-aided engine diagnostics: We find out what's really going on under the hood before we fix anything.
- Engine Repairs: Minor or major engine repairs across a wide variety of makes.
- Air-conditioning service: Get your air-conditioning blowing cold again.
- Tire Services: Rotation, tire repair, tire mounting, wheel balance and tire pressure checks.
